name: Uzoamaka Power
bio: Uzoamaka Power is a Nigerian actress.

credits.title: Dear Ajayi
credits.overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

credits.title: Phoenix Fury
credits.overview: When Ewura-Ama, recently widowed, inherits Utopia Valley, a luxury resort tucked in the quiet hills of Ghana, her search for solitude is disrupted by the arrival of a high-profile guest. Their uneasy encounter stirs tensions that awaken secrets buried decades ago.

credits.title: Blood Debt
credits.overview: In "Blood Debt", old secrets return with deadly force. When brutal killings begin, detectives uncover a dark web of revenge and corruption. As bodies pile up, who will pay for past sins? This Nollywood thriller brings big stars and non-stop suspense. In cinemas June 19 – prepare for justice, betrayal, and blood.

credits.title: Call of My Life
credits.overview: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

credits.title: ìfé: (The Sequel)
credits.overview: ìfé: (The Sequel) picks up from the events of the first film, with two women, Ife and Adaora, crossing paths again, years apart from their past passionate dalliance. credits.title: UDO
credits.overview: A couple argues about a breakup over text message, discussing their love and the importance of reassurance.

credits.title: Silence is Loud
credits.overview: Henrietta and Ayo navigate stigma, shame, and a world that would rather they stay quiet.

credits.title: Siraam
credits.overview: Explores the life of a creative and ambitious young woman as she navigates the creative industry, her sexual and reproductive health, and friendships.

credits.title: Seed
credits.overview: A psychological drama about Nnenna, who is consumed by the longing for a son after having daughters. She turns to a spiritualist’s ritual involving three sacred morning seeds. When her youngest child swallows the final seed, she spirals.

credits.title: My Father's Shadow
credits.overview: Two young brothers explore Lagos with their estranged father during the 1993 Nigerian election crisis, witnessing both the city's magnitude and their father's daily struggles as political unrest threatens their journey home.

credits.title: My Body, God's Temple
credits.overview: Omasilu and Zion are a newlywed couple who must unlearn everything they've been taught about intimacy, desire, and faith when they struggle to consummate their marriage.

credits.title: Shaping Us
credits.overview: After years of trying, Ara and Biodun are finally pregnant. On the night the couple hosts their friends for a celebratory dinner, guilt-ridden Ara gets the results of the paternity test she ordered, setting off an explosion of drama.

credits.title: Everything Lasts And Nothing Ends
credits.overview: Zainab is in Lagos for two reasons; to spread the word and chop life. Amaka is ready to pack her load and leave the city she has spent her whole life in. The worlds of the two women collide as the spirit of Lagos brings them together and threatens to pull them apart.

credits.title: A Night in 2005
credits.overview: What started out as a fun night at a prom after party in 2005, quickly turns into Ife’s worst nightmare. She carries a dark secret from that night into adulthood that continues to plague her everyday life.

credits.title: With Difficulty Comes Ease
credits.overview: Zainab, a recently widowed Muslim woman, endures the suffocating confines of her mother-in-law's home where she must remain until the end of her mandatory mourning period. credits.title: The Weekend
credits.overview: This gripping Nigerian thriller will keep you guessing until the very last moment with its unique take on the age-old question: what’s wrong with the in-laws? ​

credits.title: A Quiet Monday
credits.overview: When the leader of a secessionist group in south-eastern Nigeria is jailed, his loyalists mandate a compulsory "sit-at-home' on Mondays in protest. Siblings Kamnonu and Ogbonna face danger when they defy the Monday restrictions.

credits.title: Mami Wata
credits.overview: In the oceanside village of Iyi, the revered Mama Efe acts as an intermediary between the people and the all-powerful water deity Mami Wata. credits.title: Domitilla
credits.overview: Four prostitutes who find themselves at a crossroad must join forces in this tale of survival.

credits.title: A Naija Christmas
credits.overview: Three sons try to make their mother’s dreams come true by bringing home wives for Christmas.

credits.title: Ponzi
credits.overview: After falling prey to a Ponzi scheme, a mismatched group of people attempt to pull off an amateur heist.

credits.title: Ìfé
credits.overview: Ìfé and Adaora fall in love over a 3-day date, but will their love withstand the realities of being lesbian in Nigeria?
